title: Bitwise Reversion
statementMd:
You are given three non-negative integers $x$, $y$ and $z$. Determine whether there exist three non-negative integers $a$, $b$ and $c$ satisfying the following three conditions:

- $a \mathbin{\&} b = x$
- $b \mathbin{\&} c = y$
- $a \mathbin{\&} c = z$

where $\mathbin{\&}$ denotes the [bitwise AND operation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#AND).

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first and only line of each test case contains three integers $x$, $y$ and $z$ ($0\le x, y, z\le 10^9$) — the target values of $a \mathbin{\&} b$, $b \mathbin{\&} c$ and $a \mathbin{\&} c$, respectively.

## Output

For each test case, output "`YES`" if there exists three non-negative integers $a$, $b$, and $c$ satisfying the above conditions, and "`NO`" otherwise.

You can output the answer in any case (upper or lower). For example, the strings "`yEs`", "`yes`", "`Yes`", and "`YES`" will be recognized as positive responses.

## Note

In the first test case, $a = 3$, $b = 5$, and $c = 9$ satisfies the condition as $3 \mathbin{\&} 5 = 1$, $5 \mathbin{\&} 9 = 1$, and $3 \mathbin{\&} 9 = 1$.

In the second test case, $a = 7$, $b = 3$, and $c = 22$ satisfies the condition as $7 \mathbin{\&} 3 = 3$, $3 \mathbin{\&} 22 = 2$, and $7 \mathbin{\&} 22 = 6$.

In the third test case, it can be proven that there are no three non-negative integers $a$, $b$, and $c$ such that $a \mathbin{\&} b = 4$, $b \mathbin{\&} c = 8$, and $a \mathbin{\&} c = 12$.
statementZhMd:
给定三个非负整数 $x$、$y$ 和 $z$。请判断是否存在三个非负整数 $a$、$b$ 和 $c$，满足以下三个条件：

- $a \mathbin{\&} b = x$
- $b \mathbin{\&} c = y$
- $a \mathbin{\&} c = z$

其中 $\mathbin{\&}$ 表示[按位与运算](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#AND)。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多组测试数据。第一行包含测试数据的组数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各组测试数据的描述。

每组测试数据的第一行也是唯一一行包含三个整数 $x$、$y$ 和 $z$（$0\le x, y, z\le 10^9$）——分别表示 $a \mathbin{\&} b$、$b \mathbin{\&} c$ 和 $a \mathbin{\&} c$ 的目标值。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试数据，如果存在三个非负整数 $a$、$b$、$c$ 满足上述条件，则输出 "`YES`"，否则输出 "`NO`"。

你可以以任意大小写（大写或小写）输出答案。例如，字符串 "`yEs`"、"`yes`"、"`Yes`" 和 "`YES`" 都会被视为肯定回答。

## 说明

在第一组测试数据中，$a = 3$、$b = 5$、$c = 9$ 满足条件，因为 $3 \mathbin{\&} 5 = 1$，$5 \mathbin{\&} 9 = 1$，且 $3 \mathbin{\&} 9 = 1$。

在第二组测试数据中，$a = 7$、$b = 3$、$c = 22$ 满足条件，因为 $7 \mathbin{\&} 3 = 3$，$3 \mathbin{\&} 22 = 2$，且 $7 \mathbin{\&} 22 = 6$。

在第三组测试数据中，可以证明不存在三个非负整数 $a$、$b$、$c$，使得 $a \mathbin{\&} b = 4$，$b \mathbin{\&} c = 8$，且 $a \mathbin{\&} c = 12$。
